model: One exit order at the saved exit time. Gross sale proceeds cannot exceed the selected multiple of participation times economic volume in the 60 seconds ending five seconds before exit. Unsold inventory recovers zero. The higher-fee mode adds the excess of the prior same-pool median gas plus MEV over half the saved round-trip fee. Entry roster, size, timing, market price and 10% proceeds haircut stay fixed. Multipliers are sensitivity assumptions, not new causal policies.
scope: Fixed-roster exit-liquidity and fee sensitivity on repeatedly examined historical accounts. Volume is a proxy, not executable AMM depth. Closed-equity drawdown excludes intratrade lows and is a lower bound on drawdown. No future-data entry filter or independent profitability claim.
